 Candice Swanepoel's legs have never looked longer in never-before-seen footage from Victoria's Secret show
 Candice Swanepoel became one Victoria's Secret's most recognisable faces, opening multiple shows and modelling the $10 million Royal Fantasy Bra in 2013
 Isabelle Casey Reporter 15 hours ago Oct 24, 2026, 11:51 AM GMT+1 LEAVE A COMMENT 
 Candice Swanepoel 's model prowess has taken front and centre since her killer walk down the runway at the annual Victoria's Secret show on Sunday.
 On Friday and Saturday, the South African supermodel, who became an official angel in 2010,  continued to set our hearts ablaze as she shared a series of never-before-seen snaps from the famous show - and she has never looked better.
 Candice's BTS moments set our hearts racing 
 "The amount of content from the show had me a little stuck in between spamming you and letting it breathe…It's hard to explain the very particular feeling it is to walk the  @victoriassecret fashion show ," Candace wrote.
 You may also like
 Candice Swanepoel shows off supermodel prowess in bikini hours after Victoria's Secret show 
 Candice Swanepoel’s most iconic Victoria’s Secret runway moments 
 "Maybe some of these pictures can explain better than words can for now… while I come back to reality. Forever grateful." 
 Candice kicked off her behind-the-scenes moments with vintage-style shots from her striking bubblegum pink lingerie set, which saw her don a pair of angel wings crafted from faux blossoms and branches.
 Candice was a vision in the Spring-inspired ensemble 
 One candid shot showed Candice busy backstage, and her legs have never looked longer; the photo, taken from behind, showcased her towering legs and impressively toned glutes.
 Her look was comprised of a floral lace bodysuit with corset-style detailing around her ribs. The bodysuit was teamed with a matching lace thong and pink gloves that stretched all the way to her upper arm, punctuated with petals.
 Candice posed with Gigi Hadid 
 Candace's brilliant blonde locks were decorated with giant blossoms on either side, giving her look an otherworldly je ne sais quoi.
 Fellow Victoria's Secret angel, Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, replied to the photos with three princess emojis.
 Second time's a charm
 Alongside a second selection of BTS shots, Candice penned: "The wonder of Victoria’s Secret. A place to dream and inspire, and become our best and brightest selves." 
 This time, the 'photo dump' showed off the spellbinding white and silver set worn by the supermodel. 
 Candice gave fans a close-up look of her ultra-toned abs 
 The look was comprised of a white two-piece lingerie set over which were metallic silver chains, complete with a pair of glittering silver wings.
 These shots showed a close-up look at Candice's impressively toned abs while she was being tended to with a brush.
 Candice's impressively toned physique was captured as she walked toward the runway 
 Another showed her impressive physique in all its glory as she walked towards the runway. Meanwhile, more snaps showed Candice posing with fellow Angels Vittoria Ceretti, Behati Prinsloo Levine and Gigi Hadid, who commented with a pink love heart emoji.
